title: Rethinking Weight Decay for Robust Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models (Selective Projection Decay, SPD)
mechanism: Adam with an L2-SP style pull toward pretrained weights, applied per layer only when the layer's gradient opposes its drift from init (c_t < 0), scaled by a deviation ratio; strong pull on some layers, free movement on others.
adaptation: Apply SPD to the ResNet-34 encoder only (decoder is random init, no reference); conv1 reference = ImageNet RGB kernel summed to 1 channel as the house does. lambda grid {0.5,1,2.2}, house lr, 20k steps, CE + Dice. Replaces PF's freeze + 0.1x lr. Log per-layer cosine to init to confirm layer3/4 are kept.
evidence: PASCAL semantic seg, Swin-T IN21k, 60 epochs (read in full text, Table 4): mIoU ID / OOD-corruption avg: vanilla FT 66.03/44.00, L2-SP 73.47/56.70, LLRD 72.09/54.47, TPGM 72.56/56.96, FTP 73.79/58.45, Adam-SPD 74.27/60.06. Also DomainNet, ImageNet, LLaMA PEFT, VQA.
min_experiment: Arm SPD (encoder) vs SUP100-PF, seeds 5-9, 20k steps. Co-primaries: test clean crack relF1@2, test inactive IoU, E1 inactive IoU, E1 crack relF1@2; screen first on module-grouped 5-fold CV. Kill if no co-primary improves over PF and layer3/4 cosine to init is not higher than PF's.
prior_overlap: Partial: PF (freeze 1k + 0.1x encoder lr, no encoder wd) is a crude form of the same idea and helped E1 inactive. A per-layer selective pull toward init was never run; BRIEF section 5 lists the optimizer as never varied.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply SPD to the ResNet-34 encoder only (decoder has no pretrained reference); lambda in {0.5, 1, 2.2}; keep 20k steps, CE + Dice; replaces PF's freeze + 0.1x lr; log per-layer cosine to init to confirm layer3/4 are no longer erased.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house lr schedule + encoder SPD (3 lambdas, 5 seeds best lambda). Baseline: SUP100-PF. Metric: test clean crack relF1@2, inactive IoU, E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU. Kill: no co-primary better than PF and layer3/4 cosine to init not above PF's.
